_readme: Props are instancing-friendly GLBs: metres, Y up, origin at base centre (min y = 0). COLOR_0 holds baked ambient occlusion (multiply base colour). Materials are named after the textures in public/textures/<name>/ where applicable (rock_grey, rock_red, cliff, concrete, rust_metal...): game code may swap them. *_lod / *_billboard files are cheaper stand-ins for the same prop (same base footprint).

barrel.notes: 200 L steel drum, faded blue paint over rust, two rolling hoops, dented; textured (1024 albedo/normal/ORM)

barrel_explosive.notes: 200 L drum, red with yellow/black hazard band and flammable diamond + DANGER FLAMMABLE stencil (label faces -Y in Blender = +Z glTF, like vehicles)

billboard.notes: Large faded ad billboard: 12 x 4 m panel (bottom edge 6 m, top 10 m) on two I-beam columns with catwalk, ladder, flood lights; peeling ad texture, torn lower-left corner. readable face points to -Z in glTF (toward oncoming traffic when the road runs +Z); rotate 180 deg about Y for the other direction.

bollard.notes: 1.0 m steel bollard, faded yellow paint (texture) with two reflective bands, flanged base with anchor bolts

boulder_01.notes: rounded canyon sandstone boulder with strata; material rock_red

boulder_02.notes: rounded canyon sandstone boulder with strata; material rock_red

boulder_03.notes: rounded canyon sandstone boulder with strata; material rock_red

cactus_barrel.notes: barrel cactus 0.8 m, 16 ribs with spines on crests (texture), yellow flower ring; origin at base centre

cactus_prickly_pear.notes: prickly pear: chained flattened pads + red fruit, cactus_pear_skin (areoles); origin at base centre

cactus_saguaro.notes: saguaro with 3 arms, 12 ribs (UV u = rib index, spines on crests), cactus_skin material; origin at trunk base

canyon_pillar_a.notes: canyon hoodoo/butte, strata bands in COLOR_0; cylindrical UVs at 6 m/tile; material rock_red

canyon_pillar_b.notes: canyon hoodoo/butte, strata bands in COLOR_0; cylindrical UVs at 7 m/tile; material rock_red

crate_stack.notes: 3 weathered wooden crates (one stacked, slats missing), 2 olive ammo cans, 1 red jerrycan

dead_tree_a.notes: bare weathered snag, bark_dead texture (0.9 m/tile), origin at trunk base, no alpha cards

dead_tree_b.notes: bare weathered snag, bark_dead texture (0.9 m/tile), origin at trunk base, no alpha cards

dead_tree_c.notes: bare weathered snag, bark_dead texture (0.9 m/tile), origin at trunk base, no alpha cards

debris_pile.notes: 2 m collapsed-building rubble heap: concrete chunks, cinder blocks, planks, sheet metal, bent rebar, pipe

fence_chainlink_4m.notes: 4.0 m chain-link fence section along Z (glTF), 1.9 m high, post at the segment centre so instances tile every 4 m; mesh = alphaMode MASK double-sided card texture, torn hole near the bottom. Mesh sits on the +X side of the post.

fern.notes: fern clump: 26 arching V-folded frond cards (MASK); ~0.7 m tall, 1.4 m wide

grass_tuft.notes: dry golden grass tuft: 3 crossed vertical cards + 3 leaning fans (MASK, double-sided), ~0.50 m

grass_tuft_green.notes: green grass tuft: 3 crossed vertical cards + 3 leaning fans (MASK, double-sided), ~0.42 m

guardrail_4m.notes: W-beam guardrail, 4.0 m along Z (glTF); traffic side is +X (right shoulder when driving +Z; rotate 180 deg about Y for the left shoulder). Posts at z=+-1.0 so instances placed every 4.0 m keep a uniform 2 m post spacing; rail runs edge to edge.

jersey_barrier.notes: NJ concrete barrier 3.66 m long along Z (glTF), 0.81 m high, chipped end with exposed rebar (top-corner at +Z end)

mile_marker.notes: Highway mile marker MILE 87, plate 0.30 x 0.45 m on a 1.36 m post, leaning. readable face points to -Z in glTF (toward oncoming traffic when the road runs +Z); rotate 180 deg about Y for the other direction.

palm_coast.notes: coastal palm: ringed bark_palm trunk (curved, leans +X), 15 alpha-tested (MASK) V-folded frond cards, coconuts; origin at trunk base

pine_a_billboard.notes: crossed-quad far billboard (2 quads, 4 tris) baked from the real pine_a model (front + side view in one texture), alphaMode MASK, 9.9 x 14.8 m

pine_a_lod.notes: LOD1 of pine_a (alpha-tested cards, same materials)

shrub_dry_bush.notes: dry dead shrub / tumbleweed-like: 34 woody twigs + a few papery leaf cards; ~0.9 m

shrub_green_bush.notes: green broadleaf bush (coast / lower biomes): 46 alpha-tested cards + 3 stems; ~1.2 m

sign_exit.notes: Big green highway EXIT sign 4.0 x 2.0 m on two I-beam posts (plate bottom 2.35 m, top 4.35 m), lamp arms, folded corner. readable face points to -Z in glTF (toward oncoming traffic when the road runs +Z); rotate 180 deg about Y for the other direction.

sign_gas.notes: Roadside gas-station pole sign, 8.6 m: double-sided GAS cabinet 3.2 x 1.5 m + hanging price board 1.4 x 1.4 m (right half, one chain broken), concrete pier. Both faces readable (+Y and -Y in Blender).

sign_speed.notes: US-style speed limit 65 plate 0.76 x 0.95 m on a 2.6 m post, dented/bent, bullet holes + rust in the texture. readable face points to -Z in glTF (toward oncoming traffic when the road runs +Z); rotate 180 deg about Y for the other direction.

sign_warning.notes: Chevron / curve-arrow warning plate 0.76 x 0.95 m (arrow points to the viewer's right) on a 2.6 m post, drooping and bent. readable face points to -Z in glTF (toward oncoming traffic when the road runs +Z); rotate 180 deg about Y for the other direction.

skeleton_car_frame.notes: Burnt-out rusty car shell, 4.5 m long, front toward Blender -Y (= +Z glTF): chassis rails, floor remnants, pillars + roof rails, dash/steering wheel, seat frames, charred engine block, radiator support, wheel arches, open doors (hinged at the A pillar), bare rims on drums, exhaust/tank; no glass, no tyres.

street_lamp.notes: Highway street lamp, 9.3 m: tapered octagonal pole, 2.7 m curved arm toward +X (traffic side), cobra-head luminaire with dark 'lamp_lens' glass (swap for an emissive material if lit).

tire_stack.notes: 3 stacked + 1 leaning + 1 flat tyre (0.68 m dia), tread/sidewall texture with lettering

utility_pole.notes: 10 m leaning wooden utility pole (cross arm along X, 2.5 m), 3 glass insulators, transformer can, step bolts. Wire attach points (glTF x,y,z): (-0.9,9.4,0) (1.0,9.4,0) (0.06,10.2,0) approx; see wire_span.

wire_span.notes: 3 sagging power wires spanning 20 m along glTF +Z from the attach points of utility_pole (origin at the ground under pole A: place with the same transform as pole A, pole B stands at z=+20). Thin dark 3-sided tubes, no textures.
